pages.text: Catalysts are optional items that boost your reforge chance or guarantee success for certain item types.$(br)Here are all available catalysts:

$(li)$(item)Rabbit Hide$(): +10% success chance$(li)$(item)Ghast Tear$(): +20% success chance$(li)$(item)Eye of Ender$(): +30% success chance$(li)$(item)Heart of the Sea$(): 100% success for armor and shield
$(li)$(item)Echo Shard$(): 100% success for weapons$(li)$(item)Cooked Chorus Fruit$(): 100% success for tools$(li)$(item)Nether Star$(): +2 rarity levels on success
